jobs.txt:
Company: Flink
Title: Deployment Engineer
Location: Zürich
Visa: 
Flink Robotics is a fast-paced startup backed by world-class VCs, originating from the Computational Robotics Lab at ETH Zurich. We’re building the next generation of plug-and-play robots, powered by a novel approach to make robots autonomous. Our robots are designed to revolutionize material handling, from stacking boxes to sorting parcels and unloading goods. We’re looking for a hands-on Deployment Engineer who loves debugging, stress-testing and is ready to install robots that move the world’s parcels. In this role, you’ll be the face of Flink at customer sites and industry events, making sure every system is rigorously tested, commissioned and continuously improved. Who you are Eager to join a VC-backed startup in its early phase and take ownership of field projects. Passionate about robotics: from mechanics and electronics to computer vision and control. Proactive problem-solver wanting to learn new things Clear communicator, fluent in English, German, French, and other languages is a strong plus. Excited about frequent travel to production sites (up to 60 %). Enjoys collaborating with multidisciplinary teams an
